summary: Iterates the scene-graph children of the current object, derives a per-child detail level from a fade-distance float and geometry flags, and for children passing a threshold detail, scans their packed data array computing the squared magnitude (x*x + y*y + z*z) of each 3D vector. Returns the maximum squared magnitude found, or the most-negative double sentinel when no child qualifies.

operations.description: v11 = sub_4DD4E0(this) retrieves the minimum detail/LOD threshold for the current object.
v13 = -1.797693134862316e308 seeds the running maximum with the most-negative double.
v12 = SceneGraphChildCount(this) returns the number of scene-graph child nodes.
do-while over child index v2, advancing until v2 reaches the child count v12.
v3 = LinkedListIndexedAccessor_c230(v2) fetches the child node at index v2.
The child's float at +244 == 0.0 selects the flag-derived detail-level path; a non-zero value forces detail = 0.
Derive the detail level from the dword flags at +20: when bit 0x2000000 is set, detail = 2 - (bit 0x40 != 0), otherwise detail = 4 - (bit 0x40 != 0).
Only children whose detail level v5 is at least the threshold v11 are scanned.
v6 = PackedArrayTotalSize(v3) returns the element count of the child's packed array.
for loop over packed element index i from 0 while i < v6.
v8 = PackedArrayIndexLookup(i) returns a pointer to the i-th packed element.
v9 = v8[0]*v8[0] + v8[1]*v8[1] + v8[2]*v8[2] computes the squared magnitude of a 3D vector at the element.
When v9 exceeds the current best v13, keep it as the new running maximum.
Return the largest squared magnitude found, or the sentinel -1.797693134862316e308 when no child qualified.
